map.由贷款额、利率与月供反推还款期数 使用指南: Repayment Periods from Loan Amount, Rate and Monthly Payment User Guide
map.输入贷款本金 P、每期利率 r 与每期还款 PMT，反推还款期数 n，用于测算房: Enter loan principal P, periodic rate r and periodic payment PMT to back out the number of periods n, for estimating periods needed to clear a mortgage or car loan and planning repayment.
map.n=ln(PMT÷(PMT−P·r))÷ln(1+r)，P 本金、r 每期利率、: n = ln(PMT ÷ (PMT − P·r)) ÷ ln(1 + r), where P is principal, r the periodic rate and PMT the monthly payment. If the payment is at most the monthly interest (PMT ≤ P·r) the denominator is non-positive and there is no solution - the principal owed keeps growing, so the payment must be raised.
map.已知月供能力反推多久能还清贷款。: Back out how long until the loan is cleared from an affordable monthly payment.
map.规划车贷/房贷还款节奏。: Plan the repayment pace for a car or home loan.
map.对比提高月供后期限缩短的幅度。: Compare how much the term shortens after raising the monthly payment.
map.贷款 50 万、月利 0.4%、月供 3,000 的还清期数: Periods to clear a 500,000 loan at 0.4% monthly with a 3,000 monthly payment
map.由贷款额与抵押物价值求 LTV: LTV from Loan Amount and Collateral Value
map.由资产与负债求净资产: Net Worth from Assets and Liabilities
map.由实际年化利率与复利频率求名义利率: Nominal Rate from Effective Annual Rate and Compounding Frequency
map.月供低于利息会怎样？: What happens if the payment is below the interest?
map.若 PMT≤P·r（月息），分母 PMT−P·r≤0，公式无解——本金永远还不清: If PMT ≤ P·r (monthly interest), the denominator PMT − P·r ≤ 0 and the formula has no solution - the principal can never be cleared and keeps growing, a 'compounding interest' vicious cycle, so the payment must be raised.
map.n 不是整数怎么办？: What if n is not an integer?
map.最后一期按剩余本金单独结算。通常前 n−1 期按整额月供，末期用剩余本金+利息凑: The final installment settles separately on the remaining principal. Usually the first n−1 installments are the full monthly payment and the last one uses remaining principal plus interest to balance, so the amount differs slightly.
